title: Thai Omelette Stir Fry
description: A simple and flavorful Thai-inspired stir fry with an omelette twist. This dish is great for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tsp of vegetable oil in a medium pan over medium heat.
Pour in the eggs and cook until the eggs are almost set.
Add the cubed tofu and stir-fry sauce to the eggs and stir until the eggs are fully cooked.
Transfer the omelette to a plate and set aside.
In the same pan, add a little more oil if necessary and stir-fry any additional vegetables (such as bell peppers or carrots) until they are tender.
Return the omelette to the pan and stir-fry everything together for about 1 minute.
Optional: add garnishes such as chopped green onions or sesame seeds for extra flavor and texture.
